review: All 16 logical sheets, including eight mirrored panels, were visually checked against the published Phase 5 floor-plan PDF. The same type code can show multiple printed total areas. Several figures differ slightly from hidden text, so the display follows the visible totals. Phase 5 gallery and site plan come from the developer’s own phase page and brochure.
